messages.content: I need help coming up with a family name for my character, Juliana.   People refer to her as "the witch of many eyes" due to how her magic works.   Her name makes both fey and devils shake in their boots, as her loquacious linguistic prowess leaves them in awe, and more often then not, on the losing end of a deal.  Write each word on a new line.

- She's called "the witch of many eyes" — so something evocative of seeing, watching, omniscience
- Her magic makes fey and devils shake — so the name should sound powerful, ancient, intimidating
- She has "loquacious linguistic prowess" — she's a talker, a wordsmith, a deal-maker who wins
- She leaves them "on the losing end of a deal" — so there's something contractual, binding, about her power
